title: QE Archive ??????????????
description: Expected: QE Archive manual ingestion follows docs/architecture/qe_archive_manual_ingestion_selection_design_20260519.md end to end. Users can see experiment/task/loop archive source-status, recommendation, preview, and confirmed write actions from QE evolution, QE evolution task detail, QE experiment history, QE Archive UI, and QE Archive MCP. Actual: previously merged implementation was not validated item-by-item against the design; users reported that QE pages did not expose experiment-level and loop-level warehouse status, recommendations, or archive buttons. This is a DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 violation and must be repaired without a simplified subset delivery.
reproduce_command: Compare docs/architecture/qe_archive_manual_ingestion_selection_design_20260519.md with the current QE Archive backend, MCP, and frontend pages; verify that /quantevolver/evolution, /quantevolver/evolution/{taskId}, /quantevolver/experiments, /qe-archive, and aistock-qe-archive expose source-status, recommendation, preview, confirmed write, and loop-level selection as specified.
required_verification: frontend lint/typecheck or targeted frontend tests covering the changed QE Archive/QE pages
closure_requirements: DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 matrix maps every relevant design item to implementation references and validation evidence
source-status semantics include real archived/partial/recommended/not_recommended/manual/skip states for experiments, tasks, and loops
QE evolution main page, task detail page, experiment history page, and QE Archive page expose user-visible Chinese archive status/recommendation/action controls where required
experiment-level and loop-level archive preview and confirmed write actions use QE Archive API/MCP and require QE_ARCHIVE_WRITE for writes
loop_indices and explicit ID MCP tools work for preview and execute without scan-limit ambiguity
pages do not hide existing experiments or loops as a side effect of archive filtering
GitHub issue #106 and BUG-079 registry record are updated with branch, commit, PR/merge status, and validation evidence

events.note: User reported that previously designed QE Archive manual ingestion UI/status/actions were not visible after merge, indicating a design-compliance gap rather than a validated full implementation.
Mirrored to GitHub issue #106 via gh CLI because the live Validation MCP issue creation path still lacks GITHUB_REPOSITORY in this session.
